b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line tool for downloading files from the web.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Help Text |
|--------|-----------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o, --output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

Download a file and write it to disk:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -o file.zip
```

Download to stdout:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt
```

Silent mode:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -q
```
'
